methods.label: Apply inequality properties
methods.explanation: Subtracting 2 from both sides leaves the direction unchanged. Multiplying or dividing by a negative number reverses the direction, so B and D should be \(-a>-b\) and \(a/(-2)>b/(-2)\), respectively. Multiplying by the positive number 3 leaves the direction unchanged, so C is incorrect.
methods.levelReason: All transformations are the basic Grade 7 properties of inequalities.
